abiJson.author: Reza Apes
abiJson.description: Signed entitlement NFT collection implementing TEP-62, TEP-64 and TEP-66

declarations.name: NftItemInitAtDeployment
declarations.description: Parameters sent by a collection to initialize a deterministic NFT item.

declarations.name: ItemClaimContext
declarations.description: Context returned intact in a rich bounce if item initialization fails.

declarations.name: ClaimVoucher
declarations.description:
Domain-separated voucher signed by the backend Ed25519 key.

`collectionAddress` and `voucherDomain` prevent a valid voucher from being
replayed on another collection or network deployment. Sign the raw 32-byte
representation hash of this cell; see the checked golden vector.

declarations.name: ClaimNonce
declarations.description:
A full-width nonce kept in a reference so ClaimVoucher stays within one cell.
`value` is exactly 32 big-endian bytes on the wire.

declarations.name: ClaimMint
declarations.description:
Claim an entitled Ape. The signature is Ed25519 over the raw 32-byte
representation hash of `voucher`; see `docs/ABI.md`.

declarations.name: SetTransferFrozen
declarations.description:
Toggle collection-wide transfer policy without pausing minting. New
collections start frozen. While frozen, canonical NFT items are authorized
to move only into the deterministic personal vault of their current owner.

declarations.name: RequestTransferAuthorization
declarations.description:
Canonical item -> collection transfer-policy request. The collection
authenticates the deterministic item address from `itemIndex` before it
replies. The monotonically increasing nonce binds the reply to one pending
transfer and prevents delayed/replayed approvals.

declarations.name: CollectionImmutableConfig
declarations.description: Values that are never modified after StateInit.

declarations.name: FailedClaimRecord
declarations.description:
A claim that reached asynchronous item deployment but bounced. Retaining the
original index permits an exact retry without creating a marketplace index gap.

declarations.name: ClaimableCollectionStorage
declarations.description: Root is intentionally four references or fewer.

declarations.name: PendingNftTransfer
declarations.description:
A standard TEP-62 transfer retained while the canonical collection makes
the current, collection-wide transfer-policy decision. The item accepts at
most one pending transfer and binds the reply to a monotonic nonce.

get_methods.name: get_max_collection_supply
get_methods.description: Compile-time on-chain ceiling used by deployment tooling and verification.
